button.label: Dataset Check + Coverage
button.screentip: New sheet: dataset quality, monthly coverage, crime counts and field completeness

button.label: Duplicate / Case Review
button.screentip: Review exact duplicates, repeated incident IDs and all distinct crime types associated with each incident; no rows removed

button.label: Prepare NIBRS Crosswalk
button.screentip: Create agency-specific reviewed mapping; no broad crime-label inference

button.label: Apply NIBRS Crosswalk
button.screentip: Active crosswalk: apply approved codes to a new working dataset

button.label: Hundred-Block Builder
button.screentip: New Hundred_Blocks working table: selected source fields/rows plus hundred-block address and review status

button.label: Randomize Block Addresses
button.screentip: Generate labeled synthetic house numbers within agency hundred blocks
button.supertip: 1200 and 12XX are treated as the 1200-1299 range. Creates a new Randomized_Addresses sheet with selected fields, hundred block, synthetic address and review status. A repeatable seed and optional IncidentID keep repeated offense rows together. Generated numbers do not recover true incident locations.

button.label: Census Geocoder
button.screentip: Create Full Address and geocode distinct addresses in batches
button.supertip: Sends only address components and generated request IDs to the US Census Bureau. Creates a new Geocoded_Addresses sheet with matched address, coordinates, match quality and review flags. Shows progress; Esc cancels. Completed batch results are retained.

button.label: Timestamp Fields
button.screentip: Select a timestamp column; insert six date fields, plus Time Only and Hour when valid times exist
button.supertip: Handles mixed dates and timestamps. Text dates use US month/day/year or ISO format. All-date-only sources omit Time Only and Hour. Mixed sources retain both, with date-only rows blank. Existing columns shift right. Refreshes fields previously created by this tool.

button.label: Hour from Time
button.screentip: Select one Time column including its header; insert only Hour (0-23) beside it

button.label: Single Site
button.screentip: Crime within 0.25, 0.5 and 1 mile of a site; approximate straight-line distances

button.label: Refresh Report
button.screentip: Refresh active supported report from saved data; rebuild to reload changed source

button.label: Reset to All
button.screentip: Reset crime filter to All; retain dates, measure and other settings

button.label: Crime Concentration
button.screentip: Create a concentration dashboard with a crime-type filter and three charts
button.supertip: Map hundred-block key, crime type and optional IncidentID. Measures top 1%, 5%, 10% and 20% shares using only blocks with the selected crime. Reports actual rounded block shares, coverage and incident/record distinctions.

button.label: Temporal Heat Map
button.screentip: Choose inputs first: Date/Time, or Day of Week and Hour/Time. Then select headers and data, including Crime Type.

button.label: Repeat Locations
button.screentip: Select Address and Crime Type, with optional IncidentID/City/State. No date or time required.

button.label: Hot Streets
button.screentip: Select Hundred Block, Crime Type and Date. Time is not required. Choose week/month intervals on the new report.

button.label: Select Report Sections
button.screentip: New selector sheet: Include, Order, Section Title and Tables/Charts/Both

button.label: Export Selected Report
button.screentip: Active report selector: export combined PDF or PowerPoint

button.label: Monthly / Annual Trends
button.screentip: Date and Crime Type; optional IncidentID. Includes zero-record periods and flags partial comparisons.

button.label: Period Comparison
button.screentip: Compare two periods by crime type or qualified location; includes count differences and daily rates.

button.label: Crime Profile
button.screentip: Incident/offense totals, crime mix, coverage and top repeat addresses or blocks.

button.label: Save Image
button.screentip: Save a selected chart or formatted report range as PNG.

button.label: PowerPoint Briefing
button.screentip: Choose report sheets; create summary and chart slides as static pictures, without embedding source workbooks.

button.label: Save Report PDF
button.screentip: Export the active CAP report, including charts, with landscape pagination.
